message: 徹底的に手と手

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aaaalright, just a little more... shape it nicely...」
A small flame flickers in the palm of Nanaka's hand.

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're almost there, Treasurer-san!」

name: Sally
message: 「Pffft--!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey! Stop getting in the way!」
Between Student Council duties, special concentration training for Demon extermination.
Though anyone uninvolved seems to have plenty of free time on their hands.

name: Sally
message: 「Aaaah. I'm boooored~」

name: Misa
message: 「Hello there.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey there~」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, Misa-Misa. Wanna eat some snacks~」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh my, may I? I'll gladly have some, thank you.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, hey. Wh-wh-wh-what's Nanaka doing?」

name: Misa
message: 「I suppose she's practicing to raise her Spirit Power, may--」

name: Misa
message: 「BEEEE!?」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh-yo-yo?」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hoth!! Whath ith thith thnack?!」

name: Sally
message: 「Eeeeh?!」

name: Misa
message: 「Eek, tho hoth!! Wa-wa-water!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You can drink all the milk in the fridge.」

name: Ria
message: 「Here you go, drink up.\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「Gulp, gulp, gulp.」
Teary-eyed, she holds up her index finger.

name: Ria
message: 「Here's your refill.\s04」
Ditto.

name: Misa
message: 「Pffhaaah--! Huff, huff... Th-thank... y-you... tho much...」

name: Ria
message: 「You should thank Synn-kun, okay.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「There's plenty more if you want it. Here.」
He pulls out a bottle of milk from his jacket.

name: Misa
message: 「Noh hank yoo!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Vice-President-san, do you truly wish to grow larger that badly...」

name: Misa
message: 「Hwat hab yoo been whatching up untiw right nhow!!」

name: Sally
message: 「It was supposed to be a sweet and sour cookie, guess I got tricked again.」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm the hwun who got hricked here!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Miss Extra. Where did you obtain those sweets?」

name: Sally
message: 「The jaw-dropping Demon World Mail-Order~♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shady...」

name: Sally
message: 「They carry soba noodles too~♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Good job!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hwis isn't the hime to be chattin' idwy, ith it? We shill hab plenty of unhwanted items left to cowwect...」

name: Sally
message: 「I got no clue what you're saying.」

name: Misa
message: 「Eek!!」
And so, Misa ended up chugging down more milk.

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, we're still way short on unwanted items, so shall we go gather a bit more?」

name: Misa
message: 「I literally just said that a second ago~~!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Miss Extra. It seems you always have strange items in your possession.」

name: Sally
message: 「Demon World Mail-Order goods?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, those. You don't even have any money, so how do you get them?」

name: Sally
message: 「Bartering♪」

name: Ria
message: 「'There are some things money can't buy...'」

name: Synn
message: 「What are you trading for them?」

name: Sally
message: 「Trash from the Human World.」
How wonderful is recycling. Though some might call it a scam.

name: Lolotte
message: 「How about we use those Demon World Mail-Order goods as prizes?」

name: Misa
message: 「They're all bound to be useless junk anyway.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, if they're interesting, they'll stand out, so I don't think it's a bad idea.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Right! The shadier it looks, the more festive it feels!!」

name: Ria
message: 「No harm in trying, right? Misa-chan.」

name: Misa
message: 「If you say so, Senpai...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Omake-san. Would you be willing to let our Student Council have those fun-looking goods?」

name: Sally
message: 「Sure, I don't mind. Give me that in exchange, though.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Tontoro?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yep.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I cannot do that.」

name: Sally
message: 「Come on, it's fine, it's fine!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No means no!」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, don't be like that, come now~」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoopsie... I broke it...」
Whenever Sally-chan gets involved, things always break in no time.

name: Sally
message: 「Sorry, sorry! I really didn't mean to!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sniff~」

name: Sally
message: 「Aww, I get it, so please don't cry!」
Saying that, Sally-chan rummaged around in her pocket (?) and pulled something out.

name: Sally
message: 「Superglue. Behold, 'Mr. Sticky Beta'!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh!」

name: Sally
message: 「This oughta fix it! Over to you, Prez!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, I'm fixing it?」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm super clumsy, y'know~」

name: Ria
message: 「'I am an awkward fellow...'」

name: Synn
message: 「Guess I have no choice.」
After gathering up the 500-yen coins, I smear the glue onto the remaining shards.
I try pressing the cracked edges together, but...

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? It won't stick together at all.」
The liquid itself has zero adhesiveness. Even when I test it with a finger, it isn't the least bit sticky.

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't this defective?」

name: Sally
message: 「Is not! The label says super-strong right on it!」

name: Misa
message: 「Could it be you were swindled yet again?」

name: Sally
message: 「I said I wasn't!」

name: Misa
message: 「In that case, the issue must lie with Sakura-kun's clumsiness.」

name: Synn
message: 「Urk.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hand it to me.」
Misa reaches out to take the pieces of Tontoro and the glue from my hands.
At that exact moment, Misa's pale fingertips brush against mine.

name: Misa
message: 「O-Oh my?」
Just like that, her palm draws closer as if to cover mine. My own palm feels like it's being pulled right toward hers.

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaa.」
Or rather, it *was* pulled right to hers!

name: Synn
message: 「S-Misa, how bold of you in front of everyone...」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha--what are you saying!? You're the one pressing up against me, you pervert!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Only because you're holding my hand!」

name: Misa
message: 「I am not holding--」
Saying that, Misa swings the hand in question upward--and my arm follows right behind it.
Everything they were holding fell to the ground.

name: Misa
message: 「C-Could it be...」

name: Synn
message: 「Did we get stuck together?」

name: Misa
message: 「What on earth is going on here!!」

name: Sally
message: 「See! Sticky-Kun Beta wasn't a defective product after all!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It is completely defective!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Sally-chan. Don't you have an instruction manual or anything?」

name: Sally
message: 「It was in the way, so I tossed it.」

name: Misa
message: 「Let go of me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ow, ow, that hurts!!」

name: Ria
message: 「No, no. If you try to force yourselves apart, you might end up tearing your skin off.」

name: Misa
message: 「B-But this is...! And looking like this right in front of Big Sister...!」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't worry, it's totally fine. I don't think anything of it at a~ll.\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「~~!! Don't lose your cool, Misa. To win back her trust, I have to do something about this first...!!」

name: Synn
message: 「We're stuck together pretty tight, huh. Remover might be a bit dangerous, so why don't we try pouring cold or hot water on it for now?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I wouldn't do that if I were you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Suppose one of the adhesive's ingredients is metallic plutonium...」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What would happen?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... There'd be a massive explosion, blowing this Student Council room to smithereens.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Everyone!! Evacuate outside, hurry!!」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm not doing it!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Outta the way, outta the way!!」

name: Misa
message: 「W-W-What are you planning to do!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah... Could today be Friday the 13th?」

name: Synn
message: 「Today is Monday the 15th!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Let's end it all in one clean slash!!」

name: Misa
message: 「You'd obviously drop dead on the spot!?」

name: Sally
message: 「Then what should we do? Hey, Lolo-chi.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Tontoro...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Leave her alone for a little while.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is something wrong?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's nothing!」

name: Misa
message: 「This is bad... To think I'd have to go to the bathroom at a time like this...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If it comes to this, it's the last resort. Let's try pouring milk on it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Gaaah, what a waste! If you're gonna do that, I'll drink it!」

name: Misa
message: 「D-Don't tell me that milk from earlier is...!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Did something happen with the milk?」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No... It is nothing at all.」

name: Misa
message: 「Even if it's Onee-sama, I can't say something this embarrassing...!」

name: Misa
message: 「As things stand, I'd have to go to the bathroom with Sakura-kun-no, as if I could ever do something like that!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Mmph...」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I'm at my limit!? A-At this rate, it's going to be dangerous... Pull yourself together, Misa.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Tch, I missed...」

name: Synn
message: 「What's the big idea, throwing a punch out of nowhere!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Just shut up and lie down in the dirt!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like a mountain bandit!?」

name: Ria
message: 「'You must be joking'」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Knocking him out with a strike and trying to bury him on the spot--ruthless as always, Hiss.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So that's what it was--」

name: Misa
message: 「No, it's not!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then why are you attacking me?!」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Well, that's...~~\s01」

name: Misa
message: 「L-L-Like I could ever say something like that~!?」
She's been squirming knock-kneed for a while now, and her voice is trembling too.

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way... Do you need to use the bathroom!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Subret!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gasp.」

name: Misa
message: 「Huff, huff.」
Misa is snorting heavily through her nose. W-What is going on here!?
Where am I being carried after getting caught off guard and knocked out?

name: Synn
message: 「T-The girls' restroom!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Glare.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugyaa~, no way I can do that!!」
I scramble to my feet to run away, only to have my legs swept out from under me.

name: Synn
message: 「Oww!」
I slammed face-first into the bare ground.

name: Synn
message: 「Stop... stop it, Misa... You can't do this...」

name: Misa
message: 「I know that!! But what choice do I have!?」

name: Synn
message: 「There's gotta be some other way out of this!」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't have any room to hold it anymore!!」
Impatience and shame make both of their bodies burn hot.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Calm down, Misa. I'll go grab a potty right now!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hssss!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Right, if we use a diaper...!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hssss~~!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Why don't you just wet yourself already?」

name: Misa
message: 「Grrr!! Whose fault do you think this is!!」

name: Misa
message: 「No good, I'm at my limit. I'm killing you and dying with you!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!! Got it, I'll see no evil, hear no evil, speak no evil!!」
Out of fear and tension, sweat slowly seeps onto my palm.
Just then, the suction force suddenly weakened.

name: Synn
message: 「No way!!」
I forcefully reached toward the sink and splashed tap water over our hands.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wh-wh-what if it explodes!」

name: Synn
message: 「Water doesn't work... Which means, just as I thought...!」
I braced myself and squeezed Misa's hand tight.

name: Misa
message: 「H-hey, what are you suddenly doing!?」
Wrapping my hand around Misa's right near the girls' restroom while everyone watches... Just thinking about it is so embarrassing!!
Both of our hands grow damper and damper with sweat.
They were already soaked with enough sweat to make you want to wipe them on your clothes.
Once that heat spread across the entirety of our palms, the hands that had been pulling together until now separated without a sound.

name: Synn
message: 「S-sorry.」
The instant we separated, I scrubbed the sweat off on the hem of my uniform.

name: Synn
message: 「Sweat... or saline solution would've worked too, I just couldn't think of anything I could get ready right this second...」

name: Misa
message: 「S-so that's why... Jeez, don't startle me like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Aha, ahahaha! Sheesh, Sally-chan sure loves causing a commotion.」

name: Misa
message: 「Seriously, ugh!! I've had more than enough of Demon World gadgets...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Misa. Are you sure you don't need the bathroom?」

name: Misa
message: 「Aaaah!! Hnngh!! Get out!!」
And so, Misa's dignity was preserved.
